title: Episode About Sabo (Talwandi) Rènion (A Talwandi of Bras)

blocks.text: The Guru sends instructions toward Sirhind and beyond while still building up local strength, making clear that even from Sabo the horizon remains political and martial rather than merely contemplative. (17–18)
More men arrive for initiation, including figures tied to local lineages and service households, and khande-di-pahul continues to widen the Khalsa body through fresh adherents. (19–21)
The page closes with more followers, animals, and offerings gathering around the Guru, showing Sabo as a place where broken movement becomes renewed expansion rather than simple refuge. (22–24)
